title: EON 3 — SPORE PRINT. eco-primal as its own universe. Mining our own ethos. The third triangulation point.

eon_1.name: The Gray Void
eon_1.theme: dashboard. metrics. the HUD before it had a body.
eon_1.what_it_contributed: pin bar, data fetches, manifest integration, mono font, dark aesthetic

eon_2.name: Yggdrasil
eon_2.theme: Norse mythology. borrowed cosmology. 9 realms mapped to our components.
eon_2.what_it_contributed: atmosphere gradient, pendulum squirrel, eagle, entropy collector, realm sizing, hyperlocality

eon_3.name: Spore Print
eon_3.theme: eco-primal as its own universe. OUR mythology. OUR concepts. mined from 1002 files of our own work.
eon_3.what_it_contributed: radial gradient (brown?green?blue), concentric concept rings, gill lines, baker's dozen, sourdough cycle, Klein twist, escape velocity arc, color equation, chromatic body, intelligence band, grandmother hypothesis, central dogma, digestive tract, fold-turn

triangulation.three_points_over_MSU: eon 1 + eon 2 + eon 3 hover above MSU on the globe like three stars forming a triangle
triangulation.the_cradle_hangs_from: this triangle. the cradle of the organism hangs from these three reference points.
triangulation.compare_and_contrast: each eon is a different lens on the same data. the TRUTH is where all three agree.

the_mix.from_eon_1_and_2: ~50%. pin bar (permanent pins: Polaris, MSU, files, refs, ZK, MOR). pendulum squirrel. eagle tracker. entropy seed collector. selectivity line. live manifest fetch. heartbeat fetch.
the_mix.completely_new: ~40%. radial spore gradient. 5 concentric concept rings (brown?green?gold?blue?violet). 72 gill lines radiating from center. baker's dozen (12+1 dots). sourdough spinning ring. Klein twist overlay. escape velocity arc. color equation bar. concept nodes for: grandmother, central dogma, digestive tract, chromatic body, fold-turn, ZK, membrane, braids, chipmunk, artisan, body plan, 15 primals, RSS, trailheads, Ludo Spring, fleet, visitors, crystal ball, fossils, non-intelligence, infrastructure, overview.
the_mix.live_entropy: ~10%. FNV-1a hash from mouse/keyboard/click/scroll/touch events. performance.now() seed. screen dimensions seed. every human interaction = new entropy = new spore.

the_spore_print_metaphor.what_is_a_spore_print: a mushroom placed gill-side-down on paper leaves a pattern of spores in the shape of its gills. the pattern is unique to the species. it's how you identify a fungus without destroying it.
the_spore_print_metaphor.our_spore_print: our 1002 files placed on the page leave a pattern of CONCEPTS in concentric rings. the pattern is unique to eco-primal. it's how you identify our organism without dissecting it.
the_spore_print_metaphor.the_gills: 72 radial lines from center = the gill pattern. each gill is a thread of connection from the center (MSU) outward to the edges.
the_spore_print_metaphor.the_rings: 5 concentric bands = the growth rings. closer to center = older, denser, more fundamental. farther = newer, lighter, more speculative.
the_spore_print_metaphor.the_center: the spore origin = (0,0) = MSU. the brown dot. where the mushroom SITS. the print radiates FROM this point.

intelligence_band_applied.ring_1_brown: CLOSEST to center. grandmother, irreducible core, sourdough, central dogma. the OLDEST, most fundamental, most ALIVE concepts.
intelligence_band_applied.ring_2_green: the living membrane. digestive tract, braids, chromatic body, fold-turn, membrane, ZK. where brown meets blue = where old meets new = GREEN.
intelligence_band_applied.ring_3_gold: the pulse. heartbeat, RSS, chipmunk, artisan, body plan, 15 primals. the FUNCTIONAL layer. not as deep as core, not as far as visitors.
intelligence_band_applied.ring_4_blue: data arrives here. visitors, crystal ball, fleet, Ludo Spring, trailheads, color equation. the INCOMING. the new. the blue.
intelligence_band_applied.ring_5_violet: the edges. the overview, fossils, non-intelligence, infrastructure. the FARTHEST from the living center. the Klein twist at the boundary.
